selection_reasoning: This pair creates a natural exploration-then-action dependency chain. The player must first locate a polished granite structure/landmark in the environment, which serves as the key navigational reference point. The green concrete powder is placed adjacent to or on top of the polished granite structure, so the player cannot efficiently find and mine the green concrete powder without first discovering the polished granite landmark. Both tasks are visually distinctive (polished granite has a unique pink-speckled texture, green concrete powder is bright green), making them observable and verifiable. Neither task requires deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just navigation and block-breaking.

edges.reason: Green concrete powder is placed on/adjacent to the polished granite structure; player must find the granite landmark first to locate and mine the concrete powder

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the polished granite structure (centered at ~11.5,1,11.5) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because mining green concrete powder causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with NO green concrete powder (only a wooden pickaxe), so having ≥1 in inventory definitively proves they mined it from the scene. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

The structure has a 4x4 base (2 blocks tall) topped with a 2x2 cap (1 block tall), with green concrete powder blocks placed on the corners of the top layer and along one side at ground level. A stone brick path marks the spawn area. Oak logs provide minor scenery. The player is given a wooden pickaxe to mine blocks.
task_text: Find the polished granite structure in the environment, then mine the green concrete powder blocks located on or near it.
design_notes: The polished granite structure is at ~10,~0,~10 to ~13,~1,~13 (base, 4x4x2) with a ~11,~2,~11 to ~12,~2,~12 cap (2x2x1). Green concrete powder is at: ground level at ~14,~0,~11-13 (east side, 3 blocks) and on top corners at ~10,~2,~10 and ~13,~2,~13 (2 blocks). Total: 5 green concrete powder blocks. The structure is 2-3 blocks tall, so green blocks on top are visible from ground level and accessible by jumping onto the 1-block-high base. Player spawns at origin with stone brick underfoot and a wooden pickaxe. Distance to structure is ~14 blocks diagonally. Concrete powder is gravity-affected but all blocks rest on solid surfaces. No water in scene prevents accidental conversion to concrete.
